fullDescription: Full-bleed split-image CTA: bold left copy with dual buttons and trust chips, a drawn product-UI mock on an emerald-washed dotted-grid right half. Light mode, emerald accent, Inter, sticky frosted nav + dark footer.

structured.summary: A full-bleed split-image CTA section: bold left-aligned copy stack with dual buttons and trust chips on the left, a drawn product-UI mock (no fake browser chrome) floating on a soft emerald-washed dotted-grid right half. Sticky frosted nav above, dark full-bleed footer below. Light mode, emerald accent on near-black slate text, Inter throughout.

style.description: Clean, modern SaaS marketing aesthetic. Light background (#ffffff) with near-black slate text (#0f172a) and a single emerald accent (primary #047857 / #059669, light wash #ecfdf5). Tight negative letter-spacing on headings (down to -0.045em), generous line-height, hairline borders (rgba(15,23,42,0.06-0.09)). Soft, layered shadows for depth, rounded-full pills and rounded-[20px] cards. A subtle emerald dotted grid feathered into the right half adds texture without noise. Frosted/blurred sticky nav scrim.
style.prompt: Light-mode modern SaaS landing aesthetic. Background pure white #ffffff, body text near-black slate #0f172a with muted slate-500 #64748b for secondary copy. ONE accent color: emerald, used as #047857 (emerald-700, primary buttons + accent words), #059669 (emerald-600, icons), #10b981 (emerald-500, dots/badges), and #ecfdf5 (emerald-50, soft washes/badges). Typeface: Inter (weights 420/440/450/500/560/600/680), antialiased, with tight tracking on headings: tighter -0.034em, tightest -0.045em, body -0.018em. Hairline borders at rgba(15,23,42,0.06) to rgba(15,23,42,0.09). Rounded geometry: rounded-full pills for buttons/badges, rounded-[20px] for the product card. Layered soft shadows (e.g. 0 40px 80px -36px rgba(15,23,42,0.30)) for floating depth. A radial-dot grid in emerald rgba(16,185,129,0.16), 22px pitch, mask-feathered left-to-right behind the right half. Frosted sticky header: rgba(255,255,255,0.78) + backdrop-blur(12px) saturate(160%).

layout_and_structure.description: Full-height page: a sticky top nav, then a single two-column CTA section (max-width 1200px, ~py-28) that reflows to one column under lg, then a dark multi-column footer. Left column holds the copy+actions stack; right column holds a product-UI mock with two overlapping floating proof chips. The emerald wash + dotgrid + a white fade live as absolute layers behind the right half so there is no hard seam.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top header (top-0, z-50), frosted scrim background with backdrop-blur, bottom hairline border. Inner nav max-w-[1200px], h-16, flex justify-between, px-6/8. Left: logo = emerald-500 rounded-[9px] square (h-7 w-7) with a white sparkle icon (ph:sparkle-fill) + wordmark 'Mossly' at 16px font-600 tighter. Center (hidden under md): nav links Canvas / Library / Pricing / Docs / Changelog at 13.5px font-450 slate-500, hover to slate-900. Right: 'Log in' text link + a 'Start free' pill button (bg slate-900, white, rounded-full, px-4 py-[7px], 13.5px).

prompts.partPt: Chamada Final para Ação section shell + background layers
prompts.prompt: Section position-relative, overflow-hidden, bottom hairline border. Three pointer-events-none absolute layers on the right ~52% (lg only): (1) emerald wash bg-gradient from emerald-50 via emerald-50/35 to white; (2) the emerald dotgrid masked with linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0, #000 24%) at opacity .85; (3) a 120px white-to-transparent vertical fade at left-[46%] to soften the seam. Content wrapper relative, max-w-[1200px], px-6/8, with a grid items-center gap-12 py-20/24/28, lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-16.

Max-width 520px column. Top: an eyebrow pill (rounded-full, hairline border, bg emerald-50/70, px-3 py-[5px]) = a 1.5px emerald-500 dot + uppercase 11.5px tracking-[0.16em] emerald-700 label 'NOW WITH THE CODING-AGENT SKILL'. Then h1 at 38px (sm:56px), leading ~1.02, font-680, tightest tracking, slate-900, with a 3-line break and the final word 'an idea.' colored emerald-700. Then a 16-17.5px slate-600 subhead (max-w-440px). Then an action row (flex-col on mobile, sm:flex-row gap-3.5): primary pill button (bg emerald-700, white, rounded-full, px-7 py-[15px], 15px font-560) 'Start designing free' + right-arrow icon, and a ghost pill button (white, hairline border, slate-700) with a play-circle icon 'Watch a 90-sec build'. Below: a trust row at 12.5px slate-600 with three emerald-600 check-circle items ('No credit card', 'Free starter canvas', 'Cancel anytime') separated by thin slate-200 dividers.

A DRAWN product-UI card (not a fake browser): rounded-[20px], white, hairline border, big soft mock-shadow, overflow-hidden. Top strip (bg slate-50/70, bottom hairline): three small dots (one emerald-400, two slate-200) + a prompt pill (NOT a URL bar) - white rounded-lg with an emerald sparkle icon, truncated prompt text 'A clean SaaS billing page, emerald accent, light mode', and an emerald-700 'Run' chip with a bend-down-left icon. Body (bg slate-50/40, px-5 py-6): a generated 'Billing' mini-app card - title 'Billing' + subtitle, an emerald-50 'Active' badge; a 2-col grid of plan tiles where the 'Pro $24/mo' tile is border-2 emerald-500 on emerald-50/50 with emerald skeleton bars and the 'Team $80/mo' tile is hairline/white with slate skeleton bars; an action row = emerald-700 'Upgrade to Pro' bar + a square icon button. Below it a secondary list row (credit-card icon in emerald-50 chip, two skeleton bars, caret-right).

Two absolutely-positioned floating cards overlapping the mock (hidden on mobile, float-card shadow): bottom-left (-bottom-4 -left-3) = emerald-500 lightning chip + 'Generated in 8s' / '3 variations ready'; top-right (-top-3 right-1) = a rounded-full chip with three overlapping -space-x-2 avatar dots (emerald-300 / slate-300 / emerald-500, white ring) + '4,000+ building'.

Full-bleed footer, bg slate-950 (#020617), white text. Inner max-w-[1200px], px-6/8, py-16/20. A 12-col grid: a 4-col brand block (logo + wordmark, a 13.5px slate-400 tagline, three round social icon buttons x/github/discord with white/12 borders) then three link columns (Product / Library / Company) each with an uppercase tracking-[0.14em] slate-500 heading and 13.5px slate-300 links. A top-hairline bottom bar (border-white/10) with copyright left and Privacy / Terms / an emerald-dot 'All systems normal' status right.

special_ui_components.prompt: Eyebrow status pill (dot + uppercase tracked label) in emerald-50
Dual CTA buttons: solid emerald-700 primary + white hairline ghost, both rounded-full with icons
Inline trust row with emerald check-circle icons + thin vertical dividers
Drawn product mock with a prompt-input strip (sparkle + truncated prompt + Run chip) instead of fake browser chrome
Generated mini-app billing card with a highlighted (emerald border-2) Pro plan tile and skeleton bars
Overlapping floating proof chips (lightning 'Generated in 8s' + avatar-stack '4,000+ building')
Emerald radial-dot grid, mask-feathered into the right half

structured.special_notes: Legibility-fixed variant: the right-half emerald wash is feathered (mask + white fade at the seam) so it never bleeds under the headline, and the floating chips are kept clear of the h1. Keep to ONE accent (emerald) on near-black slate text. Heading tracking is aggressively tight (down to -0.045em) - preserve it. Icons via Iconify Phosphor (ph:*). On <lg the grid collapses to one column and the right-half background layers are hidden; on mobile the floating chips and dividers hide. Fonts: Inter only.
